qa_pairs.question: What is the specific web address for the Metrix portal dedicated to the Rorqual cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: The specific web address for the Metrix portal dedicated to the Rorqual cluster is https://metrix.rorqual.alliancecan.ca.

qa_pairs.question: What is the purpose of the Metrix portal accessible via the URL https://metrix.rorqual.alliancecan.ca?
qa_pairs.answer: The Metrix portal, accessible via https://metrix.rorqual.alliancecan.ca, is a website for Alliance users to interactively track their real-time usage of resources such as CPU, GPU, memory, and file systems on the Rorqual cluster.
